lauren: Quick sync: want a compact "mini-eval" under /optimize showing SDK -> batching -> KV cache -> quant profile in one place. Copy-pasteable into CI. Who can take the snippet + tiny perf numbers?

jessica: PR checklist: examples/optimize/mini_eval_rundown.py, examples/tests/test_mini_eval_rundown.py (mocked smoke), update nav, 2 short rec bullets about cache vs batch, add 1-line migration note for legacy batch_* keys.

mike: Draft snippet (to be included in PR):

```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
c = RedwoodClient(api_key="$REDWOOD_KEY")
# int8 favors throughput; fp16 favors quality
q = {"preferred_dtype": "int8"}
resp = c.generate(
  model="rw-opt-quant-8b",
  input="Summarize this customer chat in 2 bullets:\n- ...",
  batch_options={"max_batch_latency_ms": 25, "max_batch_size": 6},
  cache={"kv_prefetch": True},
  quant_profile=q
)
print(resp.text)
```

lauren: Keep the Recommendations section to two non-prescriptive bullets: cache for repeated prefixes; larger batch for tolerant latency budgets.
